devil_advocate_text: mB+ is mB plus two operators Baltag and Smets defined twenty years ago, in models that already interpreted them, so the extension is a parser change rather than a semantic one. The action layer, observability model and product update are transcribed from Buckingham. The evaluation is two domains, single runs, unnamed hardware, and a 5-10% claim with no stated protocol. The artefact is a model checker in a field whose central problem is planning, which the paper concedes it does not do.

concerns: The nugget (introspection collapse) is on page 7 and absent from the abstract
suggestions: Move the introspection result into the abstract and introduction
reviews.feedback_text: Hook: K_i box_i phi = K_i phi. Genuine and non-obvious. Buried.

concerns: Prop 3.7 defeasibility characterisation has no proof and is load-bearing
Cor 3.9 asserted valid, follows from Thm 3.8 in one line
Prop 7.2 bisimulation soundness and congruence asserted flat
No complexity analysis anywhere
Thm 3.4 is a proof sketch for four separate claims
suggestions: Prove 3.7, 3.9 and 7.2 or downgrade and cite precisely
Add a complexity subsection for model checking and enumeration
reviews.feedback_text: Rigor 3/5. Three load-bearing statements carry no proof, verified by audit of the source.

concerns: Two domains in tables; Muddy Children quoted in prose only
No hardware, compiler version, run count or variance
5-10% random-model claim has no protocol
287 tests is engineering evidence, not semantic evidence
No runtime comparison to EFP/PDKB despite comparing in tables
suggestions: Add Muddy Children as a table
Either compare runtimes or say why the comparison is not meaningful

concerns: Framed as a system description while the best content is three findings
The update-rule divergence is the strongest result and appears as a Remark
suggestions: Promote the divergence to a numbered proposition with the case analysis
Lead the contributions with the findings rather than the tool

Four scenarios used, none developed as a running example
suggestions: Adopt one running example and carry it through every section
reviews.feedback_text: Clarity 3/5. Figure audit: no figures exist.

baral entry lacks year and venue

concerns: Implicit: the analyst knows which world is actual, load-bearing for every box judgement
Implicit: domains are small enough for explicit-state model checking
reviews.feedback_text: Finiteness, local connectedness and the single-class precondition are stated. Two are not.

Strongest case: three findings not in the sources, of which the update-rule divergence is decisive for anyone implementing this semantics. Audience: builders of epistemic planners over plausibility models. No fatal soundness flaw found.
Ethics flags: none. Broader impact: not applicable at this scope. Recommendation: proceed.
